tenant.title: Tenants
tenant.description: Each tenant has its own database, domains, and admin accounts. Provisioning runs in the background and emails an activation link to the first administrator when it finishes.
tenant.provisioningHint: Creating the database and first administrator. This page updates automatically when it's done.

hint.code: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Can't be changed later. The default domain is {{domain}}.
hint.adminEmail: An activation email goes here after provisioning; this person sets a password and manages the tenant.

error.codeInvalid: Use 3–32 lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens, starting with a letter
error.codeReserved: This code is reserved by the system

disable.title: Disable tenant
disable.confirm: All of {{code}}'s domains will become unavailable and everyone signed in will be signed out. You can enable it again later.

remove.title: Delete tenant
remove.confirm: Delete {{code}}: the tenant is disabled and removed from the list, and its domains are released. The database and files aren't removed right away; that's a separate manual step.
remove.typeToConfirm: Type the tenant code {{code}} to confirm

domain.title: Domains
domain.removeConfirm: After removal, {{domain}} immediately stops leading to this tenant: people using it are locked out, and bookmarks and links in old emails stop working.
domain.primaryHint: The primary domain can't be removed: email links and tenant sign-in use it.

feature.title: Enabled features
feature.description: Tenant users only see enabled features; the API treats turned-off features as nonexistent. Data is kept and comes back when you turn a feature on again.
feature.fileDescription: File manager, folders and access grants.
feature.auditLogDescription: Browse the tenant's activity (entries are still recorded).
feature.jobDescription: View and retry the tenant's background jobs (jobs still run).
feature.trashDescription: Browse and restore deleted items, including the "Undo" after a delete. When off, deleted items are still purged after the retention period.
feature.systemSettingDescription: Lets tenant admins adjust runtime settings. When off, adjusted values stay in effect but can't be viewed or changed.
feature.identityProviderDescription: Lets the tenant configure OIDC identity providers so users can sign in with external accounts. When off, sign-in doesn't redirect to an external IdP; registered connections are kept.
feature.identityProviderDisableWarning: {{code}} users can no longer sign in through an external IdP, and SSO-only domains fall back to password sign-in; users who only ever signed in through an external IdP must reset their password first.
feature.tenantSwitchDescription: The "Switch tenant" item in the user menu, which opens the page for entering a tenant code. Deployments serving a single tenant can turn it off.
feature.webhookDescription: Lets the tenant configure webhooks that send events to external systems. When off, no events are sent; subscriptions and delivery logs are kept.
feature.webhookDisableWarning: {{code}} webhooks stop sending, and events that occur in the meantime are not sent later when you turn this back on.
feature.disableConfirm: After turning this off, {{code}} users immediately lose access to "{{feature}}" and anyone on its pages is sent back to the home page. Data is kept and comes back when you turn it on again.

impact.ssoOnlyDomains_one: {{count}} SSO-only domain will fall back to password sign-in
impact.ssoOnlyDomains_other: {{count}} SSO-only domains will fall back to password sign-in
impact.passwordlessExternalUsers_one: {{count}} user signs in only through the external IdP and has no password; they must reset it first
impact.passwordlessExternalUsers_other: {{count}} users sign in only through the external IdP and have no password; they must reset it first
impact.groupMembers_one: {{count}} user is a member of a group
impact.approvalFlowsUsingOrg_one: {{count}} approval flow uses managers as reviewers
impact.approvalFlowsUsingOrg_other: {{count}} approval flows use managers as reviewers

feature.announcementDescription: Tenant admins write announcements and send them as in-app notifications to selected people, groups, roles, or everyone, immediately or on a schedule.
feature.announcementDisableWarning: Scheduled announcements for {{code}} stop sending; times missed while disabled are not sent when re-enabled. Announcements and their history are kept.
feature.externalApiDescription: Service accounts, personal API tokens, and the external API that outside systems call with API tokens. When off, the backstage has no service account page or token sections and every external API call returns 404; service accounts and tokens are kept, and existing tokens work again as soon as it is turned back on.
feature.externalApiDisableWarning: Every integration calling the external API with an API token for {{code}} fails immediately (404), and service accounts and tokens cannot be managed in the backstage (including revoking them) until this is turned back on.
feature.groupDescription: Organize users into groups to assign roles, grant folder access, and target announcements. When off, the backstage has no group page and everything granted through groups is suspended; groups, members, and grants are kept and take effect again as soon as it is turned back on.
feature.groupDisableWarning: Roles, folder access, and announcement audiences that {{code}} users get through groups stop applying immediately until this is turned back on; anyone whose admin access comes only from a group loses it.
feature.dataTransferDescription: Bulk import data from CSV/XLSX and export lists and audit logs to files. When off, the pages and endpoints disappear; existing export files are removed when they expire.
feature.organizationDescription: Department tree, members and managers; multi-step approvals can route to the requester's manager or a department's managers. When off, the organization page disappears; departments and members are kept and come back when turned on again.
feature.organizationDisableWarning: Approval steps of {{code}} that use managers or department managers as reviewers will find no reviewers and go to people with "Override approvals".
feature.approvalChainDescription: Sequential steps, multi-person sign-off and conditional routing for approval types. Single-step approvals are not affected.
feature.approvalChainDisableWarning: New requests of {{code}} become single-step; in-flight multi-step requests are decided in one go by people with "Review requests". Flows are kept; undecided requests continue from their step when turned on again.

flag.title: Feature flags
flag.description: Turn trial features on or off for this tenant only. “Follow platform” uses the platform-wide setting and the default. While a flag is on the kill switch, this setting has no effect.
flag.killed: Kill switch is on for all tenants
flag.offConfirm: After turning this off, {{code}} users immediately lose "{{key}}".

tenant.provisionWarning: Provisioning finished, but a follow-up step didn't succeed (the tenant is usable; file storage is retried on the first upload): {{reason}}

file.storageQuotaMbDescription: Total size of all files, including uploads in progress and files in the trash (thumbnails excluded). Lowering it below current usage deletes nothing; it only blocks new uploads.

auditLog.hotRetentionDaysDescription: Audit records older than this are moved to the archive table daily. Both remain searchable; archive queries are slower.
auditLog.retentionDaysDescription: Archived records older than this are deleted a whole month at a time (daily; each deletion is itself audited). At least 365 days; -1 keeps them forever. Records are always kept at least as long as the hot retention.

job.maxConcurrencyDescription: Maximum background jobs of any kind running at once for this tenant. Extra jobs wait a few seconds and run later; they do not count as failures.

identityProvider.maxProvidersDescription: Maximum identity provider connections the tenant can create. Lowering it does not remove existing connections.

webhook.maxUrlsDescription: Distinct URLs the tenant's webhooks can notify. Tenants already over the limit can still edit and remove URLs but cannot add more.

param.rangeError: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}

rateLimit.authPerMinuteDescription: Maximum sign-in requests per minute across the whole tenant. Under attack, only this tenant gets "too many requests"; other tenants are unaffected.
rateLimit.trustedCidrsDescription: The customer's office or VPN ranges (CIDR, separated by commas or spaces, e.g. 203.0.113.0/24). Sign-ins from these networks get 10× the per-IP limit, so a whole company behind one NAT is not throttled; per-account limits, delays and lockout still apply.

dataTransfer.importMaxRowsDescription: Maximum rows in one import (one file). Users are asked to split larger files. Controls server load for analysis and applying.
dataTransfer.importMaxSizeMbDescription: Maximum size of a file uploaded for analysis; the data submitted for applying may be up to twice this size.
dataTransfer.exportMaxRowsDescription: Maximum rows in one export. Users are asked to narrow the filters.

limits.title: Tenant-wide limits
limits.description: Limits that apply to the whole tenant rather than a specific feature.

mfa.title: MFA verification methods
mfa.description: Which multi-factor authentication methods this tenant can use. "Platform default" follows the platform-wide setting; methods switched off platform-wide are always off.
